name: oss-ai-skills
description: Open Source AI Skills — domain-bundled plugins for Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Antigravity.

plugins.name: oss-django-stack
plugins.description: Full-stack Django web development: core ORM, admin theming, REST APIs, HTMX, Celery background tasks, Redis, and pytest.

plugins.name: oss-python-backend
plugins.description: Modern Python async microservices, HTTP APIs, database ORMs, caching, data validation, and automated testing.

plugins.name: oss-qt-desktop
plugins.description: Cross-platform GUI development with Qt in Python (PyQt6/PySide6) and C++, plus KDE Plasma widgets and Kate editor extensions.

plugins.name: oss-rust-stack
plugins.description: Idiomatic Rust systems engineering, high-performance terminal user interfaces with Ratatui, and structural AST code refactoring.

plugins.name: oss-web-frontend-testing
plugins.description: Web UI engineering with Tailwind CSS v4, visual regression testing with Playwright, dynamic reactive server UI with HTMX, and AST linting.

plugins.name: oss-browser-extensions
plugins.description: Browser and mail extension development for Firefox WebExtensions and Thunderbird MailExtensions with E2E visual regression testing.

plugins.name: oss-game-dev-emulation
plugins.description: 2D game development in Python (pygame), GBA Lua game engine, mGBA emulator automation, and OpenRCT2 modding.

plugins.name: oss-ai-agent-dev
plugins.description: AI agent engineering, RAG pipelines with LlamaIndex, OpenCode agent plugin architecture, and structured schema validation.

plugins.name: oss-linux-desktop-tools
plugins.description: Linux desktop utilities, Waydroid Android container integration, KDE Plasma 6 desktop widgets, and local Redis caching.

plugins.name: oss-app-extensibility
plugins.description: Scripting and extending open-source desktop software: GIMP 3.0+ Python plugins, Kate editor C++ plugins, OpenRCT2 game mods, and OpenCode tools.
